I've reviewed all implementation source. Key terminology mapping in the code: `labels`=tags, `readLater`=unread/read-later, `putAway`=archive. Now I have enough to judge every requirement from the code.

Notable findings: there is no `note` field anywhere in the data model, edit dialog, or capture (edit dialog only has title/description/url); search is a structured multi-field filter (plain-text AND, a separate "Exact phrase" field, exclude-site, label checkboxes) with no `#tag` syntax, no boolean/parenthesis operators, and no in-query quote parsing; save flow collects metadata server-side with no pre-save edit; saved searches store included labels + a domain-exclude field but no excluded-tags; no Internet Archive integration.
